# o11y_alert_runbook_usage (Data Source)

Reads definitions, exact definition revisions, and incidents linked to a managed runbook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "runbook_id" {
  description = "id of an o11y_alert_runbook."
  type        = string
}

data "o11y_alert_runbook_usage" "checkout" {
  runbook_id = var.runbook_id
}

output "linked_alert_ids" {
  value = data.o11y_alert_runbook_usage.checkout.definition_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `runbook_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `definition_ids` (List of String)
- `definition_revision_ids` (List of String)
- `incident_ids` (List of String)
